001package net.tnemc.paper;
002
003import net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperCalculationsProvider;
004import net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack;
005import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
006import org.bukkit.block.ShulkerBox;
007import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
008import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
009import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.BlockStateMeta;
010import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.BundleMeta;
011import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta;
012
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Collection;
015import java.util.Iterator;
016import java.util.function.Function;
017
018public final class PaperInventoryCalculations extends PaperCalculationsProvider {
019
020  @Override
021  public int removeAll(final PaperItemStack stack, final Inventory inventory, final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
022
023    return edit(inventory, staged -> Integer.MAX_VALUE - remove(stack, staged, Integer.MAX_VALUE, useShulker, useBundles));
024  }
025
026  @Override
027  public int removeItem(final PaperItemStack stack, final Inventory inventory, final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
028
029    return edit(inventory, staged -> remove(stack, staged, stack.amount(), useShulker, useBundles));
030  }
031
032  @Override
033  public void takeItems(final Collection<PaperItemStack> items, final Inventory inventory,
034                        final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
035
036    edit(inventory, staged -> {
037      items.forEach(item -> remove(item, staged, item.amount(), useShulker, useBundles));
038      return null;
039    });
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public Collection<PaperItemStack> giveItems(final Collection<PaperItemStack> items, final Inventory inventory,
044                                             final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
045
046    return edit(inventory, staged -> super.giveItems(items, staged, useShulker, useBundles));
047  }
048
049  private int remove(final PaperItemStack currency, final Inventory inventory, final int amount,
050                     final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
051
052    if(amount < 0) {
053      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot remove a negative item amount");
054    }
055    int remaining = amount;
056    final int storageSize = inventory.getStorageContents().length;
057    for(int slot = 0; slot < storageSize && remaining > 0; slot++) {
058      final ItemStack item = inventory.getItem(slot);
059      if(item == null || item.getType().isAir()) {
060        continue;
061      }
062      if(currency.provider().similar(currency, item)) {
063        final int removed = Math.min(remaining, item.getAmount());
064        remaining -= removed;
065        item.setAmount(item.getAmount() - removed);
066        inventory.setItem(slot, item.getAmount() == 0 ? null : item);
067        continue;
068      }
069      remaining = removeContents(currency, item, remaining, useShulker, useBundles);
070      inventory.setItem(slot, item);
071    }
072    return remaining;
073  }
074
075  private int removeContents(final PaperItemStack currency, final ItemStack item, final int amount,
076                             final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
077
078    int remaining = amount;
079    final ItemMeta meta = item.getItemMeta();
080    if(useShulker && meta instanceof BlockStateMeta block && block.getBlockState() instanceof ShulkerBox shulker) {
081      remaining = remove(currency, shulker.getInventory(), remaining, false, false);
082      if(remaining != amount) {
083        block.setBlockState(shulker);
084        item.setItemMeta(block);
085      }
086    }
087    if(useBundles && meta instanceof BundleMeta bundle) {
088      remaining = removeBundle(currency, bundle, remaining);
089      if(remaining != amount) {
090        item.setItemMeta(bundle);
091      }
092    }
093    return remaining;
094  }
095
096  private int removeBundle(final PaperItemStack currency, final BundleMeta bundle, final int amount) {
097
098    int remaining = amount;
099    final ArrayList<ItemStack> contents = new ArrayList<>(bundle.getItems());
100    final Iterator<ItemStack> iterator = contents.iterator();
101    while(iterator.hasNext() && remaining > 0) {
102      final ItemStack item = iterator.next();
103      if(currency.provider().similar(currency, item)) {
104        final int removed = Math.min(remaining, item.getAmount());
105        remaining -= removed;
106        if(removed == item.getAmount()) {
107          iterator.remove();
108        } else {
109          item.setAmount(item.getAmount() - removed);
110        }
111      }
112    }
113    bundle.setItems(contents);
114    return remaining;
115  }
116
117  private <Result> Result edit(final Inventory inventory, final Function<Inventory, Result> operation) {
118
119    final ItemStack[] contents = inventory.getStorageContents();
120    final Inventory staged = contents.length % 9 == 0 ? Bukkit.createInventory(null, contents.length)
121                                                     : Bukkit.createInventory(null, inventory.getType());
122    if(staged.getStorageContents().length != contents.length) {
123      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported inventory storage layout: " + inventory.getType());
124    }
125    staged.setMaxStackSize(inventory.getMaxStackSize());
126    for(int slot = 0; slot < contents.length; slot++) {
127      if(contents[slot] != null) {
128        staged.setItem(slot, contents[slot].clone());
129      }
130    }
131    final Result result = operation.apply(staged);
132    inventory.setStorageContents(staged.getStorageContents());
133    return result;
134  }
135}
